title: Zomboid Control Panel
description: Create the first admin account for this panel, then continue to the rest of setup.
cardDescription: This account unlocks the control panel and signs you in right away.
footer: Store this password safely. There is no email recovery — resetting it later requires filesystem access to this server.

setupToken.label: Setup Token
setupToken.placeholder: Paste the token from the startup log
setupToken.help: Printed to the panel's startup log or console output the first time it runs, to prove you're the one setting it up. Restart the panel to print it again if you've lost it.

username.label: Username
username.hintEmpty: Use 3-32 characters: letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.

panelPort.label: Panel Port
panelPort.help: Port used to open the panel. Default: 3001. If it is busy, the panel will choose and save a free port automatically.

confirmPassword.label: Confirm Password
confirmPassword.hint: Type the same password again to confirm it.

rememberMe: Keep me signed in on this browser
rememberMeHelp: Skips the login screen next time you open the panel in this browser. Leave this off on a shared or public computer — anyone who uses that browser afterward would be able to control this server without a password.

errors.setupTokenRequired: Enter the setup token printed to the panel's startup log or console output.
errors.invalidSetupToken: Invalid or missing setup token. Check the panel's startup log or console output for the one-time token.
errors.invalidUsername: Username must be 3-32 characters (letters, numbers, _ or -)
errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters
errors.invalidPort: Panel port must be a whole number between 1024 and 65535

afterThisStep.heading: After this step
afterThisStep.step1Title: Bring a server into the panel
afterThisStep.step1Desc: Add an existing install or run the guided setup to create one.
afterThisStep.step2Desc: The panel needs to authenticate against the server before it can do anything useful.
afterThisStep.step3Desc: Verify status, players, backups, and quick admin actions from one screen.
